title: lycopodium phlegmaria var. australe
intro: Lycopodium phlegmaria var. australe, commonly known as Spiny Club Moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family, specifically a variety of the Lycopodium phlegmaria species. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium phlegmaria var. australe include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
